mainEntity.name: How much does garage drywall installation cost in Denver or Centennial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing usually depends on square footage, finish quality, ceiling height, and whether the job includes fire-rated board, demolition, or texture matching. In Denver-area markets, smaller projects may land in the low thousands, while larger or more detailed garages cost more.
